protocol_metadata.name: Frozen Empirical Superconductivity Discovery Benchmark Protocol
protocol_metadata.description: Standardized, leakage-free empirical time-split discovery benchmark evaluating literature-gap models against true future superconductor discoveries across historical cutoffs.

candidate_pool_definition.domain: Full Periodic Table Unordered Binary Pairs (Z=1 to Z=118)
candidate_pool_definition.filtering_rule: Exclude all pairs (E1, E2) that co-occurred within the SAME compound formula in pre-cutoff papers (year <= cutoff_year).
candidate_pool_definition.pool_size_range: 5,300 to 5,900 untried candidate pairs across 2012-2022 cutoffs
candidate_pool_definition.temporal_isolation: Strictly zero look-ahead: candidate pool, graph co-occurrences, and frequency counts are computed exclusively from pre-cutoff papers.

rules: Formula-like tokens only (length >= 2, must contain uppercase letter and periodic table element)
English words / word stems rejected: any token containing 3 or more consecutive lowercase letters ([a-z]{3,}) is strictly rejected
Common acronyms rejected: SRF, TDGL, BCS, DFT, NMR, TEM, SEM, STM, AFM, EDS, SQUID, PPMS, ARPES, DOS, SOC, QCP, CDW, SDW, CW, MBE, PLD, CVD, 2DEG, etc.
Dummy species rejected: any token producing pymatgen DummySpecies is rejected
Masking: critical temperature notations (Tc = 39 K, T_c, etc.), units (Ne FIB, K-band, Kelvin), and single English words colliding with element symbols (In, As, Be, At, K, I, Pm) are masked
Transuranic cutoff: elements with Z > 94 (beyond Plutonium) are strictly excluded

hit_assertion_specification.criterion: Candidate element pair must appear within the SAME compound formula in a post-cutoff paper (year > cutoff_year).
approved_venues: arXiv cond-mat.supr-con (or cond-mat.mtrl-sci with verified superconductivity focus)

Recognized peer-reviewed journals (publisher DOI prefixes: APS 10.1103, Nature 10.1038, Elsevier 10.1016, IOP 10.1088, AIP 10.1063, ACS 10.1021, Springer 10.1007, Wiley 10.1002, JPS 10.1143/10.7566, Oxford 10.1093, PNAS 10.1073, MDPI 10.3390, EDP 10.1051, Taylor&Francis 10.1080)
excluded_venues: ChemRxiv, Research Square, bioRxiv, and non-arXiv unrefereed servers

metrics_reported: Wilson Score 95% Confidence Interval for hit rate (0-100%)
Paired Bootstrap 95% Confidence Interval for Δ(Model - Frequency) at K
Full Pool ROC AUC for Model, Frequency, Similarity, and Random
Full Pool Mean Rank for Model, Frequency, Similarity, and Random
Paired Bootstrap 95% Confidence Interval for Δ(Model - Frequency) ROC AUC

pool_variants_history_and_rejections.description: Any abstract mentioning both elements anywhere in text counted as tested pre-cutoff and hit post-cutoff.
pool_variants_history_and_rejections.reason: Massive false positives on incidental co-mentions across separate sentences, substrate materials (e.g. Si, Al2O3), and unrelated biological/medical chemistry.

pool_variants_history_and_rejections.variant: Variant 2: Untried pairs among pre-cutoff elements with min-frequency >= 2 or 3
pool_variants_history_and_rejections.description: Restricted candidate search pool to combinations of elements with >= 2 pre-cutoff occurrences.
pool_variants_history_and_rejections.reason: Artificially shrank pool to ~1,600 pairs, concentrating ubiquitous elements and driving background random hit rate to 26%-41%, which violates the metric validity ceiling (<20%).

pool_variants_history_and_rejections.variant: Variant 3: Elements Z <= 94 without dummy species / acronym filtering
pool_variants_history_and_rejections.description: Used elements up to Plutonium, but formula parser lacked lowercase English word rejection and DummySpecies rejection.
pool_variants_history_and_rejections.reason: Acronyms like 'SRF' (Superconducting Radio Frequency) and 'TDGL' were parsed as compounds (e.g., S-F, Ra-Fr), producing spurious post-cutoff hits and elevating 2015 random rate to 20.71%.

pool_variants_history_and_rejections.variant: Variant 4: Frozen Protocol (All 118 periodic table elements, strict pymatgen formula parser, venue validation)
pool_variants_history_and_rejections.description: Evaluates all 6,903 binary pairs across Z=1..118, excluding genuine compound formula co-occurrences pre-cutoff. Post-cutoff hits strictly require formula co-occurrence in approved venues.
pool_variants_history_and_rejections.reason: Chemically and mathematically sound, unbiased over the full chemical domain, zero look-ahead, and keeps background random rate strictly between 7.6% and 12.1% (well below 20.0%) across all cutoffs.
